url.name: URL
url.title: URL QR Code Generator
url.metaDescription: Turn any link into a QR code for free. Customize colors and add your logo, then download your URL QR code in PNG or SVG.
url.intro: A URL QR code sends people straight to a web page when scanned. Use it on posters, packaging, business cards and menus to drive traffic to your website, landing page or online store.

text.name: Text
text.title: Text QR Code Generator
text.metaDescription: Create a QR code that shows plain text when scanned. Works offline, free and without sign-up.
text.intro: A text QR code stores a message directly inside the code, so it can be read without an internet connection. Perfect for instructions, serial numbers, short notes or hidden messages.

email.name: Email
email.title: Email QR Code Generator
email.metaDescription: Generate an email QR code with a prefilled recipient, subject and message. Free and customizable.
email.intro: An email QR code opens the scanner's mail app with the recipient, subject and body already filled in. Great for customer support, feedback requests and contests.

phone.name: Phone
phone.title: Phone Call QR Code Generator
phone.metaDescription: Create a QR code that dials a phone number when scanned. Free, fast and customizable.
phone.intro: A phone QR code lets people call you with a single scan, without typing the number. Ideal for flyers, shop windows, vehicles and business cards.

sms.name: SMS
sms.title: SMS QR Code Generator
sms.metaDescription: Make an SMS QR code that opens a prefilled text message. Free QR code generator with logo.
sms.intro: An SMS QR code opens the messaging app with your number and message ready to send. Use it for opt-ins, votes, bookings and quick feedback.

wifi.name: WiFi
wifi.title: WiFi QR Code Generator
wifi.metaDescription: Create a WiFi QR code so guests can join your network without typing the password. Supports WPA, WEP and open networks.
wifi.intro: A WiFi QR code lets guests connect to your wireless network instantly. Print it for your home, office, café, hotel or event — nobody has to type a long password again.

vcard.name: vCard
vcard.title: vCard QR Code Generator
vcard.metaDescription: Create a vCard QR code for your business card. Share your name, phone, email, company and address in one scan.
vcard.intro: A vCard QR code saves your contact details straight into the scanner's phone book. Add it to business cards, email signatures and badges to make networking effortless.

location.name: Location
location.title: Location QR Code Generator
location.metaDescription: Generate a QR code that opens a location on Google Maps. Help customers find your shop or event easily.
location.intro: A location QR code opens a precise place on the map so people can get directions in one tap. Perfect for shops, restaurants, venues and real-estate listings.

event.name: Event
event.title: Event QR Code Generator
event.metaDescription: Create an event QR code that adds your event to the calendar with date, time and location.
event.intro: An event QR code adds your meeting, party or conference to the scanner's calendar with all the details. Print it on invitations, tickets and posters.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp QR Code Generator
whatsapp.metaDescription: Create a WhatsApp QR code that opens a chat with your number and a prefilled message. Free and customizable.
whatsapp.intro: A WhatsApp QR code starts a conversation with your business instantly. Use it on packaging, receipts and ads to make it easy for customers to contact you.

howto.title: How to create a QR code

steps.d: Pick what your QR code should do: open a link, connect to WiFi, share a contact and more.
Fill in the details, then change colors, dot shapes, corners and add your own logo.
Download your QR code as PNG, JPG, WEBP or vector SVG in high resolution, ready for print.

items.d: Create unlimited QR codes without registration or hidden fees.
Static QR codes work forever — the data is stored inside the code.
Colors, gradients, dot shapes, corner styles and your logo.
Export up to 2000 px or as infinitely scalable SVG vectors.
Codes are generated in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
Readable by every modern phone camera and QR scanner app.

items.q: Is this QR code generator really free?
items.a: Yes. You can create and download as many QR codes as you want, for personal or commercial use, without signing up.
No. These are static QR codes: the content is encoded directly in the image, so they keep working forever.

items.q: Can I add a logo to my QR code?
items.a: Yes. Open the Logo tab, upload your image and adjust its size. Use a higher error-correction level to keep the code readable.

items.q: Which file format should I download?
items.a: Use SVG for print and large formats because it scales without losing quality. PNG is best for websites and documents.

items.q: Why won't my QR code scan?
items.a: Make sure there is enough contrast between the code and background, keep a quiet zone around it, avoid an oversized logo and print it at least 2 × 2 cm.
No. QR codes are generated locally in your browser and we do not store the content you enter.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Learn how our QR code generator handles your data and cookies.

sections.p: QR codes are generated entirely in your browser. The content you type or the logos you upload are not sent to or stored on our servers.

We use a cookie to remember your preferred language. Third-party partners such as advertising networks and analytics providers may set their own cookies to serve and measure ads, including personalised ads based on your previous visits to this and other websites.

This website displays ads from third-party networks (for example Google AdSense). These vendors may use cookies or similar technologies. You can opt out of personalised advertising through your browser settings or the vendor's ad settings page, such as https://adssettings.google.com.
We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the website means you accept the updated policy.
